snippet.title: Legion Breaker - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Legion Breaker is an active incremental game about growing a novice wizard into an unstoppable battlemage. Unlock powerful spells, raise a holy army, and crush undead hordes across expanding battlefields on your way to the Necromancer King.

Buy now on Steam!
